shots.title: Refuse to overwrite an existing sprint review without --force and validate required sections before closing review_md (#616)

hazards.description: [architect review] --force missing from registry help; reviewRequiredSections consumed unvalidated (TypeError risk on malformed config); stdout/disk repair asymmetry; refusal message understated gate effect. All fixed.

[code review] Marker-presence check let human-enriched generated reviews be silently clobbered and misclassified authored files that quoted the marker; fixed with a line-1 content-hash marker (pristine-only regeneration).
[code review] Missing required sections did not reopen an already-closed review_md gate; repair table lacked right-double-quote and ellipsis forms; section check was unanchored substring. All fixed.
[code review] Re-review R1: gate reopen leaked into view-only --stdout/--output runs, flipping review_md without touching disk. Fixed by scoping gate mutation to canonical-path runs.

shots.notes: Generated reviews carry a marker comment; unmarked (project-authored) files are never overwritten without --force, the kept file still satisfies the gate, identical regeneration is a no-op, and reviewRequiredSections config gates review_md on required headings.

shots.title: Emit UTF-8-clean review markdown across platforms (#616)
shots.notes: Empty-cell placeholders switched from em dashes to ASCII '--', and repairMojibake fixes cp1252-mangled sequences arriving from input data.

shots.title: Reconcile sprint lifecycle to merged state after post-merge retro and correct the next-action text (#611)
shots.notes: Reproduced live during S241 closeout: post-merge retro set phase=complete but sprint status still derived ready_for_pr from gates alone. Status now short-circuits on the complete phase and the next action says the sprint is closed out.

conditions: S240 had already shipped the phase-reconciliation half of #611; the residual bug was in status derivation, found by dogfooding the retro during S241 closeout.
bunker_locations: A sprint claiming to fix an issue in its scorecard does not mean the issue is closed — S240 claimed #611/#608 while #611 remained half-broken.
yardage_book_updates: sprint status derives its headline from gates AND phase now; phase complete is terminal (set by post-merge retro).
Generated sprint reviews start with the marker comment; regenerating historical unmarked reviews requires --force.
course_management_notes: Executed S242-3 first while the #611 repro from S241's closeout was live in the working state.
